# Test query for non-defaults in the env

# Go+BoringCrypto conflicts with GOFIPS140.
[GOEXPERIMENT:boringcrypto] skip

env BOLERO_ROOT=./a
env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=local
env BOLERO_SUMDB=nodefault
env BOLERO_PROXY=nodefault
env BOLERO_MODULE=auto
env CGO_CFLAGS=nodefault
env CGO_CPPFLAGS=nodefault
env GOFIPS140=latest
[cgo] env CGO_ENABLED=0
env GCCGO=nodefault

bolero env -changed
# linux output like BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN='local'
# windows output like BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=local
stdout 'BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=''?local''?'
stdout 'BOLERO_SUMDB=''?nodefault''?'
stdout 'BOLERO_PROXY=''?nodefault''?'
stdout 'BOLERO_MODULE=''?auto''?'
stdout 'CGO_CFLAGS=''?nodefault''?'
stdout 'CGO_CPPFLAGS=''?nodefault''?'
stdout 'GOFIPS140=''?latest''?'
[cgo] stdout 'CGO_ENABLED=''?0''?'
stdout 'GCCGO=''?nodefault''?'

bolero env -changed -json
stdout '"BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN": "local"'
stdout '"BOLERO_SUMDB": "nodefault"'
stdout '"BOLERO_PROXY": "nodefault"'
stdout '"BOLERO_MODULE": "auto"'
stdout '"CGO_CFLAGS": "nodefault"'
stdout '"CGO_CPPFLAGS": "nodefault"'
stdout '"GOFIPS140": "latest"'
[cgo] stdout '"CGO_ENABLED": "0"'
stdout '"GCCGO": "nodefault"'

[GOOS:windows] env GOOS=linux
[!GOOS:windows] env GOOS=windows
[GOARCH:amd64] env GOARCH=arm64
[!GOARCH:amd64] env GOARCH=amd64

bolero env -changed GOOS
[GOOS:windows] stdout 'set GOOS=linux'
[!GOOS:windows] stdout 'GOOS=''windows'''
bolero env -changed GOARCH
[GOARCH:amd64] stdout 'set GOARCH=arm64|GOARCH=''arm64'''
[!GOARCH:amd64] stdout 'set GOARCH=amd64|GOARCH=''amd64'''

bolero env -changed -json GOOS
[GOOS:windows] stdout '"GOOS": "linux"'
[!GOOS:windows] stdout '"GOOS": "windows"'
bolero env -changed -json GOARCH
[GOARCH:amd64] stdout '"GOARCH": "arm64"'
[!GOARCH:amd64] stdout '"GOARCH": "amd64"'

env GOARCH=amd64
env GOAMD64=v3
bolero env -changed
stdout 'GOAMD64=''?v3''?'

env BOLERO_PROXY=s
bolero env -changed BOLERO_PROXY
! stdout 'BOLERO_PROXY'
env BOLERO_PROXY=s2
bolero env -changed BOLERO_PROXY
stdout 'BOLERO_PROXY=''?s2''?'

env BOLERO_ROOT=./b
bolero env -changed
! stdout 'BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=''?local''?'

[GOOS:windows] env LocalAppData=C:\
[GOOS:windows] env BOLERO_CACHE=C:\go-build
[GOOS:windows] bolero env -changed
[GOOS:windows] ! stdout 'BOLERO_CACHE'

-- a/bolero.env --
BOLERO_PROXY=s
GOAMD64=v1
GOFIPS140=off

-- b/bolero.env --
BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=local
